import math

def stderr(p, n):
    return math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n)

    se = stderr(p, n)
    return (p - 1.96 * se, p + 1.96 * se)

def ztest_prop(p1, n1, p2, n2):
    """Two-proportion z-test (two-sided)"""
    p_hat = (p1 * n1 + p2 * n2) / (n1 + n2)
    se = math.sqrt(p_hat * (1 - p_hat) * (1/n1 + 1/n2))
    if se == 0:
        return 0, 1.0
    z = (p1 - p2) / se
    # Approximate p-value using normal CDF
    p_val = 2 * (1 - normal_cdf(abs(z)))
    return z, p_val
